text.en:
This Order may be cited as the Stamp Act (Amendment) Order, 2026 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2013 .
Repeal of Part 9 of Chapter 34

Part 9 of the Stamp Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is repealed .
Amendment of Schedule 1

heading.en: Schedule 1 to the Act is amended -

text.en:
The provisions of the other written laws specified in the first column of the Schedule are amended in the manner set out in the second column thereof.
89 12th. MARCH, 2026 APPENDIX B, item no . 41, Delete "Collector of Estate Duty" and page 583 substitute with "Probate Officer" therefor.

Universiti Brunei Darussalam Act (Chapter 157)
Section 9 Repeal.

Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali Act (Chapter 212)
Section 9 Repeal.

Section 26 Repeal.
Made this 22nd. day of Ramadhan, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the 12th. day of March, 2026 at Our Istana Nurul !man, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.
91 HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
